title: Lens Waltz
style: Playful orchestral skating waltz in 3/4 that turns into a heavy comic march when the giant appears, then back to a warm waltz.
key: D major -> D minor (giant) -> D major
rules: Original instrumental only. No vocals, no lyrics, no spoken word.

hit_points.cue: Waltz starts instantly on beat one, glockenspiel melody.
Accordion joins; waltz full and bouncy.
Music thins to celesta and flute only.
Waltz stops dead; low timpani hits match each THOOM.
Comic giant march in D minor, tuba on footsteps.
Frantic pizzicato runs over the march.
Waltz returns as a heroic march-waltz, brass enters.
Waltz theme returns, gentle and warm on strings.
Full waltz finale, cymbal swell, final D major chord exactly at the cut.

end_card.cue: Music resolves on the final chord exactly at the cut; ODDLY sting plays over 2.0s end card.
